items.change: Each materialized prompt file contained the exact frozen JSON prompt string plus one trailing LF. Run records preserve the materialized-file SHA; the output manifest records both hashes.
hh-01 trial 3 and hh-02 trial 3 first attempts were discarded before blinding because one mate was malformed or used invalid metadata; both arms were rerun in fresh contexts.
Three accepted run records used synonymous metadata keys. The original answer text was not regenerated or edited; keys were normalized and then the complete 42-run validator was rerun.

Before the judgment lock and before mapping reveal, independence_level was mechanically renamed to the required independence key. Scores, preferences, flags, rationales, and evaluator IDs were unchanged.

Three fresh per-packet evaluator contexts self-reported separate_context_same_model rather than the more specific extension separate_context_same_model_per_packet. The lower claim is preserved in the lock.
Agents were explicitly limited to the frozen local skill, but the globally installed candidate could not be excluded by an OS-level model sandbox.
All 42 generators and 63 judges used fresh contexts in the same model family and inherited configuration; this is not external replication.
